headline-lg.purpose: Main technical page headings and catalog titles.

headline-md.purpose: Section headings and prominent panel headers.

headline-sm.purpose: Card titles, demos, and compact page headings.

body-md.purpose: Product copy, descriptions, and explanatory text.

body-sm.purpose: Field help and compact explanatory text.

label-md.purpose: Buttons, tabs, navigation, controls, and terse metadata.

label-sm.purpose: Compact labels, terse metadata, and figure labels.

code-sm.purpose: Inline technical references and compact code-adjacent labels.

body-serif.purpose: Brand marks and deliberate editorial accents.

body-serif-secondary.purpose: Longer secondary editorial passages with a traditional reading rhythm.

audio-label.purpose: Compact uppercase instrument labels; not essential explanatory copy.

shadows.name: surface-low
shadows.purpose: Current shared cards, floating sidebars, active tab surfaces, popovers, dropdowns, dialogs, and tooltips.

shadows.name: input-low
shadows.purpose: Outline buttons and fields where a barely raised edge improves affordance.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Pressed transport feedback and immediate mechanical states.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Default hover, focus, selected, open, and closed state changes.

motion.name: ambient-contract
motion.purpose: Themes may tune ambient intensity and easing, but must provide reduced-motion and meaningful static states.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact TX-02 action bound to semantic theme roles.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet tonal action for supporting choices within a local surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--secondary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action with explicit mode-aware fill, hover, and focus states.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } :host-context(.dark) .ds-btn-outline { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 30%, transparent); border-color: var(--input); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Chrome-free supporting action that gains semantic accent contrast on interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Compact text-first navigation with visible current location and semantic interaction states.
components.html: PreviewComponentsTokens
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 14px/20px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 50%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact full-round label whose geometry communicates status or category.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: fit-content; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sharp 36px field with semantic border and a strong mode-independent focus contract.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 16px/24px var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-input { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } } :host-context(.dark) .ds-input { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input) 30%, transparent); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Square bordered panel with the shared Card spacing rhythm and ratified radius-none geometry.

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 20px/28px var(--font-tx-02), ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Audio Transport Button
components.description: Tactile domain control whose gradient materials live in the sidecar because the frontmatter component schema cannot represent gradients.
components.css: .ds-audio-transport { display: inline-flex; width: 32px; height: 28px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--audio-control-border); border-radius: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--audio-control-start), var(--audio-control-mid) 40%, var(--audio-control-end)); color: var(--audio-control-icon); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, white 50%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, white 40%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, black 12%, transparent); transition: box-shadow 75ms ease-out; } .ds-audio-transport svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-audio-transport:active { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--audio-control-active-start), var(--audio-control-active-mid) 60%, var(--audio-control-active-end)); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px color-mix(in oklch, black 20%, transparent), inset 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, black 10%, transparent); } .ds-audio-transport:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Oscilloscope Trace
components.description: Current dark-oriented P31 preview; dedicated light and dark oscilloscope treatments remain implementation work.
components.css: .ds-scope { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--oscilloscope-trace) 22%, transparent); border-radius: 0; background: var(--oscilloscope-shoulder); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--oscilloscope-floor) 45%, transparent); } .ds-scope svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .ds-scope path { fill: none; stroke: var(--oscilloscope-trace); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: square; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--oscilloscope-glow) 45%, transparent)); }

narrative.overview:
KKB is a design substrate for a personal technical-creative studio. It should feel precise, rhythmic, detailed, and visibly crafted while remaining open enough to support audio systems, shaders, WebGPU, Three.js, high-quality animation, generative graphics, sigils, advanced symbols, diagrams, and interactive technical artifacts.

The system distinguishes a stable visual language from selectable atmosphere. Typography, geometry, spacing, symbology, component anatomy, interaction behavior, and accessibility stay consistent across themes by default. Themes primarily change curated light and dark palettes, surface character, visualization colors, shader parameters, procedural texture, and subtle qualities of motion or depth. A theme changes the atmosphere, not the product.

`@kkb/ui` is the shared implementation foundation. Its semantic tokens and reusable components keep apps, demos, docs, reports, and experiments within one product family without forcing every surface into the same composition. Operational, editorial, expressive, instrument-like, and immersive surfaces may all use either light or dark mode. The web app's `/ui` route inventories and visually verifies these components through a dense Preview wall and focused component item views; it does not host complete application shells.

The initial atmosphere is intentionally limited to one curated light/dark pair. Phosphor is the initial utility-icon vocabulary, distinct from custom KKB sigils and symbols. Owned shared primitives use Base UI, with native implementations where Base has no matching primitive; retained Radix packages are transitive dependencies of out-of-scope integrations. JSON-render remains an experimental capability outside the active design-system roadmap.
keyCharacteristics: Complete, deliberately curated light and dark modes are required for every theme.
Geist carries readable prose; TX-02 carries technical headings, labels, code, and telemetry.
Mekzantine, EB Garamond, and Departure Mono provide deliberate secondary voices rather than replacing the core pairing.
Structural surfaces and ordinary controls use radius-none; explicitly named functional mechanics retain inherent roundness.
Phosphor carries utility icons while custom KKB sigils and symbols remain a separate identity layer.
Semantic component roles remain stable while colors, shader treatments, and subtle material feel vary by theme.
Dynamic visuals provide light, dark, reduced-motion, meaningful static, responsive, and accessible representations.
Expressive graphics add identity without replacing navigation, product meaning, or accessibility.

rules.name: The Stable Language Rule
rules.body: Theme changes preserve typography roles, geometry, spacing rhythm, component anatomy, interaction semantics, and symbology unless an explicitly experimental theme documents an exception.

rules.name: The Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Themes may change color, materials, visualization palettes, shaders, procedural texture, and subtle motion character; they must not silently redesign layout or behavior.

rules.name: The Paired Mode Rule
rules.body: Every theme ships light and dark as deliberately tuned counterparts. Dark mode is not a mechanical inversion of light mode.

rules.name: The Semantic Role Rule
rules.body: Components consume semantic roles such as `background`, `foreground`, `border`, `ring`, and domain-specific signal roles; they do not branch on theme names or hard-code atmosphere colors.

rules.name: The Initial Spectrum Rule
rules.body: Audio blue and P31 green describe the current theme, not permanent global hues. Other themes may remap their palettes, but they must preserve domain meaning and accessible state distinctions.

rules.name: The Geist Reading Rule
rules.body: Sustained reading belongs to Geist. Mono identifies technical context; it does not replace readable prose.

rules.name: The TX-02 Workshop Rule
rules.body: TX-02 carries the stable technical voice across themes. Color and material may change around it, but the role does not.

rules.name: The Secondary Voice Rule
rules.body: Mekzantine, EB Garamond, and Departure Mono are selective accents. A surface must have a specific editorial, symbolic, or lo-fi reason to invoke them.

rules.name: The Surface–Mode Independence Rule
rules.body: Operational, editorial, expressive, instrument-like, and immersive compositions may all be rendered in light or dark mode.

rules.name: The No Document Overflow Rule
rules.body: Dense technical content stays inside its own responsive or focusable region; it never enlarges the page viewport.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: If a shadow does not communicate overlay, state, or instrument material, remove it.

rules.name: The Rendered Light Rule
rules.body: Shader light belongs to the visual system that produced it. Do not imitate bloom with unrelated component shadows.

rules.name: The Stable Geometry Rule
rules.body: Themes do not change component geometry, control dimensions, border logic, or symbol construction by default.

rules.name: The Functional Roundness Rule
rules.body: Rounded geometry is limited to the approved identity and mechanical exceptions; it never softens an ordinary structural surface or control.

dos: Do treat `packages/ui/src/styles/globals.css` as the live token source of truth and this document as its normative design interpretation.
Do preserve semantic token names across themes and provide complete light and dark mappings for each theme.
Do keep typography, geometry, spacing, symbology, component anatomy, and interaction semantics stable by default.
Do use Geist for continuous reading, TX-02 for technical context, and secondary faces only with a clear editorial or symbolic purpose.
Do use the 4px rhythm, radius-none structural geometry, structural borders, visible focus, and paired foreground tokens.
Do limit rounded geometry to the approved functional parts whose identity or mechanical behavior requires it.
Do move reusable visual and interaction contracts into `@kkb/ui` instead of duplicating them across apps.
Do design responsive figures as distinct compositions when scaling alone would damage comprehension.
Do provide light, dark, reduced-motion, meaningful static, responsive, and accessible representations for dynamic media.
donts: Don't equate dark mode with technical or expressive work, or light mode with product or operational work.
Don't generate one color mode by mechanically inverting the other.
Don't let a theme move controls, change component APIs, replace symbol meanings, or materially alter information hierarchy.
Don't hard-code theme-specific colors inside shared components when a semantic role should own the decision.
Don't treat the initial audio blue or oscilloscope green as mandatory hues for every future theme.
Don't use low-contrast metadata, hover-only exploration, color-only selection, inaccessible horizontal scrolling, or document-level overflow.
Don't round ordinary buttons, fields, cards, panels, menus, overlays, navigation items, or containers.
Don't add rounded soft cards, pillowy inputs, glassmorphism, heavy decorative gradients, or generic glossy SaaS styling to the core language.
Don't create app-local primitives when an equivalent or composable `@kkb/ui` foundation exists.
Don't turn `/ui` into a workshop index, docs site, or gallery of complete experiment and instrument applications; it is the component inventory and focused inspection surface.
Don't extract complete route composition into `@kkb/ui` before real consumers establish a reusable component seam.
Don't treat JSON-render as part of the active design-system roadmap.
